title: The compaction watermark advances before any text exists, so a compaction with no resolvable section is consumed silently and never retried

detail: Root cause of the operator lead: buildCompactionPart writes the watermark at compaction-context.mjs:231 before building sections, then returns empty at :252 when no section resolves; the seen filter at :220/:223 suppresses every later attempt. Proven by repro: same journal, fresh state dir returns 1199 chars, consumed state dir returns 0.

e5b8611a4fa did not touch compaction-context.mjs; it only added the hand-over part to the three composers, so the defect predates the commit and the new part changed only which call reaches the detector first.
